prompt: Use our existing logging setup to make inventory import events easy to scan locally and search during production incidents.
setup: The repository has an approved structured logger, a console formatter, and an OpenTelemetry bridge that supports named records and propagates trace context.
Policy permits counts and durations but excludes item contents and operator identity for this event.
expected: The existing logger and formatter present the same event contract, with stable names and typed attributes in production and readable text locally.
The mapping uses EventName, optional Body display text, Attributes, the appropriate severity fields, and existing TraceId and SpanId.
Operators can identify completed imports and filter by numeric counts or duration even without a message. Any included summary remains stable.
must_not: Require a message, JSON encoding, a new logging library, or a wrapper that enforces no additional invariant.
Copy item contents, operator identity, or other unneeded data into either output.
